title: The beginning
blurb: The Quran gives the order of these events, not their dates. The sequence is fixed; the years are unknown.

events.title: Adam, the first human
events.what: Allah creates Adam, teaches him the names of all things, and makes him the first prophet.

events.title: Iblis refuses to bow
events.what: The angels bow to Adam. Iblis refuses out of pride and vows to mislead Adam's children.

events.title: Sent down to earth
events.what: Adam and Hawwa eat from the forbidden tree, repent, and are sent down to earth. Allah accepts their repentance.

events.title: Habil and Qabil
events.what: One son of Adam kills the other. The Quran uses it to teach that killing one person is like killing all people.

events.title: Prophet Idris
events.what: Prophet Idris, praised as truthful and raised to a high station. Tradition credits him with the first writing and sewing.

events.title: Nuh builds the ark
events.what: Nuh preaches for 950 years. His people reject him, so he builds the ark on Allah's command.

events.title: The Flood
events.what: The flood drowns the deniers, including Nuh's own son. The ark comes to rest on Mount Judi.
